blocks.zh: 附錄 4.1 良好儲存與運輸實務查核表（第一部分）
blocks.en: Appendix 4.1 Good Storage and Shipping Practices Checklist (Part 1)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解 GDP 稽核查核表的結構與各類別涵蓋範圍
blocks.en: Understand the structure of the GDP audit checklist and the scope of each category

blocks.zh: 掌握認證與許可（Accreditation & Licensure）、品質系統（Quality System）的查核要點
blocks.en: Master the key audit points for Accreditation & Licensure and the Quality System

blocks.zh: 理解設施管理（Facilities）中建築維護、蟲害防治的稽核重點
blocks.en: Understand the audit focus for Facilities, including building maintenance and pest control

blocks.zh: 學習產品管控（Product Control）中儲存、溫控校正、庫存管理與配送的查核項目
blocks.en: Learn the checklist items under Product Control for storage, temperature calibration, inventory control and distribution

blocks.zh: 能運用此查核表對經銷商、第三方物流或服務供應商進行系統性 GDP 評估
blocks.en: Be able to use this checklist to carry out a systematic GDP assessment of distributors, third-party logistics providers or service providers

blocks.zh: 4.1 Good Storage and Shipping Practices Checklist 4.1 良好儲存與運輸規範查核表
blocks.en: 4.1 Good Storage and Shipping Practices Checklist

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GDP 查核表的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Role of the GDP Checklist

blocks.zh: Good Distribution Practices (GDP，優良運銷規範) 是確保藥品在離開製造廠後到抵達患者手中之前，品質不受損害的關鍵規範。此查核表是 PDA TR52 提供的實用稽核工具，適用於：
blocks.en: Good Distribution Practices (GDP) are the key requirements for ensuring that a medicinal product is not compromised in quality between leaving the manufacturer and reaching the patient. This checklist is a practical audit tool provided by PDA TR52 and applies to:

blocks.zh: Distribution Centers (配送中心)：藥品倉儲與物流樞紐
blocks.en: Distribution Centers: warehousing and logistics hubs for medicines

blocks.zh: Wholesalers (批發商)：藥品中間流通商
blocks.en: Wholesalers: intermediate distributors of medicines

blocks.zh: 3rd Party Distributors (第三方經銷商)：受委託的物流服務業者
blocks.en: 3rd Party Distributors: contracted logistics service providers

blocks.zh: Service Providers (服務供應商)：提供冷鏈、運輸等專業服務者
blocks.en: Service Providers: providers of specialized services such as cold chain and transportation

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 這份查核表就像是「餐廳衛生稽核表」——即使廚師（製造商）做出了完美的料理，如果外送過程中溫度失控、包裝破損、路線不當，食物品質一樣會大打折扣。GDP 查核表確保「從廚房到餐桌」的每一段路程都受到管控。
blocks.en: This checklist is like a "restaurant hygiene inspection form". Even if the chef (the manufacturer) prepares a perfect dish, food quality will still suffer if the temperature goes out of control during delivery, the packaging is damaged or the route is poorly chosen. The GDP checklist ensures that every leg of the journey "from kitchen to table" is controlled.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：表頭資訊的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: Why the Header Information Matters

blocks.zh: 查核表開頭的基本資訊欄位看似簡單，但卻是稽核紀錄的法規基礎：
blocks.en: The basic information fields at the top of the checklist look simple, but they form the regulatory foundation of the audit record:

blocks.zh: BoP (Board of Pharmacy) 登記號：各州藥局委員會的合法營運許可
blocks.en: BoP (Board of Pharmacy) registration number: the state board of pharmacy license to operate legally

blocks.zh: DEA 登記號：管制藥品處理的聯邦授權（如適用）
blocks.en: DEA registration number: federal authorization to handle controlled substances (if applicable)

blocks.zh: 明確記錄受訪者身份與稽核員資訊，是確保稽核報告具備可追溯性 (Traceability) 的關鍵
blocks.en: Clearly recording the identity of the interviewees and the auditor is essential to ensuring the traceability of the audit report

blocks.zh: A. Accreditation and Licensure（認證與許可）
blocks.en: A. Accreditation and Licensure

blocks.zh: 核心概念：認證與許可的意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Meaning of Accreditation and Licensure

blocks.zh: Accreditation (認證) 與 Licensure (許可) 是藥品經銷商合法營運的基本門檻。主要認證類型包括：
blocks.en: Accreditation and Licensure are the basic thresholds for a pharmaceutical distributor to operate legally. The main types of accreditation include:

blocks.zh: ISO：國際標準化組織認證，如 ISO 9001 品質管理體系
blocks.en: ISO: certification by the International Organization for Standardization, such as ISO 9001 quality management systems

blocks.zh: cGMP：現行良好製造規範
blocks.en: cGMP: current Good Manufacturing Practice

blocks.zh: GDP：優良運銷規範
blocks.en: GDP: Good Distribution Practice

blocks.zh: BoP：州藥局委員會登記
blocks.en: BoP: registration with the state Board of Pharmacy

blocks.zh: VAWD (Verified-Accredited Wholesale Distributors)：NABP 認證的合格批發經銷商，是美國藥品供應鏈中特別重要的認證標準
blocks.en: VAWD (Verified-Accredited Wholesale Distributors): NABP accreditation of qualified wholesale distributors, an especially important accreditation standard in the US pharmaceutical supply chain

blocks.zh: 重點提示：稽核歷史的價值
blocks.en: Key Point: The Value of Audit History

blocks.zh: 第 2 題詢問的「最近一次外部稽核」資訊至關重要。若一家經銷商長期未接受外部稽核（如超過 2 年），這是一個重大的紅旗警示。合格的 GDP 設施通常會定期接受多方面的稽核，包括：客戶稽核、州藥局檢查、FDA 檢查等。
blocks.en: The information requested in Question 2 on the "most recent external audit" is critical. If a distributor has gone a long time without an external audit (for example, more than 2 years), this is a major red flag. A qualified GDP facility is normally audited regularly by several parties, including customer audits, state board of pharmacy inspections and FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Points to Consider

blocks.zh: 如果一家經銷商擁有 ISO 9001 認證但沒有 VAWD 認證，這對於在美國分銷藥品意味著什麼？
blocks.en: If a distributor holds ISO 9001 certification but not VAWD accreditation, what does this mean for distributing medicines in the US?

blocks.zh: 「維持許可的系統」(第 3 題) 為何重要？若許可過期會產生什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why is the "system for maintaining licenses" (Question 3) important? What are the consequences if a license lapses?

blocks.zh: B. Quality System（品質系統）
blocks.en: B. Quality System

blocks.zh: 核心概念：藥品配送的品質管理系統 (QMS)
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Quality Management System (QMS) for Pharmaceutical Distribution

blocks.zh: 品質系統是 GDP 的核心支柱。本節 17 個問題涵蓋了一個完整 QMS 的所有關鍵要素：
blocks.en: The quality system is the core pillar of GDP. The 17 questions in this section cover all the key elements of a complete QMS:

blocks.zh: 獨立品質組織 (Q1)：品質部門必須獨立於營運部門，避免利益衝突
blocks.en: Independent quality organization (Q1): the quality unit must be independent of operations to avoid conflicts of interest

blocks.zh: Quality by Design, QbD (Q2)：將品質設計融入流程，而非事後檢驗
blocks.en: Quality by Design, QbD (Q2): build quality into the process rather than relying on after-the-fact inspection

blocks.zh: 管理審查 (Q3)：系統性的定期檢討，涵蓋 8 大面向
blocks.en: Management review (Q3): a systematic, periodic review covering 8 major areas

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統 (Q11)：糾正與預防措施，是持續改善的引擎
blocks.en: CAPA system (Q11): corrective and preventive action, the engine of continual improvement

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：品質系統如同汽車的安全系統
blocks.en: Analogy: The Quality System as a Car's Safety System

blocks.zh: 品質系統就像一輛車的完整安全配備：
blocks.en: A quality system is like the complete set of safety equipment in a car:

blocks.zh: 校正程序 = 定期校準儀表板（確保溫度計讀數準確）
blocks.en: Calibration procedures = regular calibration of the dashboard instruments (ensuring thermometer readings are accurate)

blocks.zh: 偏差調查 = 行車紀錄器（出事時能回溯原因）
blocks.en: Deviation investigation = the dashcam (the cause can be traced back when something goes wrong)

blocks.zh: CAPA = 召回通知與改進設計（發現煞車問題後全面改善）
blocks.en: CAPA = a recall notice and design improvement (a comprehensive fix after a braking problem is found)

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤 = GPS 紀錄（可追溯每一段路程）
blocks.en: Audit trail = the GPS log (every leg of the journey can be traced)

blocks.zh: 變更管制 = 改裝需經原廠認證（任何改變都需評估影響）
blocks.en: Change control = modifications require factory approval (any change must be assessed for impact)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：管理審查的 8 大面向
blocks.en: Key Point: The 8 Areas of Management Review

blocks.zh: 第 3 題列出的管理審查項目完整對應 ISO 9001 管理審查要求，這體現了 GDP 與品質管理體系的高度整合。特別注意：
blocks.en: The management review items listed in Question 3 correspond fully to the management review requirements of ISO 9001, which reflects how closely GDP is integrated with quality management systems. Pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: 數據趨勢分析：不只看單次事件，更要看趨勢變化
blocks.en: Data trend analysis: look not only at single events but at changes over time

blocks.zh: CAPA 狀態追蹤：確保矯正措施被落實而非只是紙上談兵
blocks.en: CAPA status tracking: ensure corrective actions are actually implemented and not just on paper

blocks.zh: 業務變化影響評估：如擴大配送範圍、新增產品線等變化都需評估對品質的影響
blocks.en: Impact assessment of business changes: changes such as expanding the distribution area or adding product lines must be assessed for their effect on quality

blocks.zh: 重點提示：運輸範圍的建立 (Q8)
blocks.en: Key Point: Establishing Shipping Ranges (Q8)

blocks.zh: Allowable Shipping Ranges (允許運輸範圍) 是 GDP 中常被忽略的關鍵要素。運輸溫度範圍必須基於：
blocks.en: Allowable Shipping Ranges are a key element of GDP that is often overlooked. The shipping temperature range must be based on:

blocks.zh: 產品穩定性數據 (Stability Data)
blocks.en: Product stability data

blocks.zh: 包裝驗證結果 (Packaging Qualification)
blocks.en: Packaging qualification results

blocks.zh: 季節性溫度變化考量
blocks.en: Consideration of seasonal temperature variation

blocks.zh: 運輸路線與時間的分析
blocks.en: Analysis of transport routes and transit times

blocks.zh: 為什麼品質組織必須「獨立」(separate and distinct)？如果品質人員同時負責營運，可能會產生什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why must the quality organization be "separate and distinct"? What problems could arise if quality personnel are also responsible for operations?

blocks.zh: 第 17 題提到的 audit trail（稽核追蹤）在藥品召回時扮演什麼角色？若追蹤不完整，後果為何？
blocks.en: What role does the audit trail mentioned in Question 17 play during a product recall? What are the consequences if the traceability is incomplete?

blocks.zh: I. FACILITIES - C. Building and Housekeeping（設施 - 建築與環境維護）
blocks.en: I. FACILITIES - C. Building and Housekeeping

blocks.zh: 核心概念：建築與環境維護的三大面向
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Dimensions of Building and Housekeeping

blocks.zh: 本節 23 個問題可歸納為三大主軸：
blocks.en: The 23 questions in this section can be grouped into three main themes:

blocks.zh: 清潔與衛生 (Q1-Q8)：包括清潔計劃、SOP、清潔紀錄、清潔用品隔離、危害物質管理
blocks.en: Cleanliness and hygiene (Q1-Q8): cleaning program, SOPs, cleaning records, segregation of cleaning supplies, hazardous materials management

blocks.zh: 設施完整性 (Q9-Q16)：屋頂滲漏、排水高度、照明、門禁安全、區域隔離
blocks.en: Facility integrity (Q9-Q16): roof leaks, elevation above flood level, lighting, access security, area segregation

blocks.zh: 基礎設施保障 (Q17-Q23)：備用電源、周界安全、環境警報、維護管理
blocks.en: Infrastructure safeguards (Q17-Q23): backup power, perimeter security, environmental alarms, maintenance management

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：倉庫如同手術室的延伸
blocks.en: Analogy: The Warehouse as an Extension of the Operating Room

blocks.zh: 雖然藥品倉庫不需要達到無菌室的等級，但概念是相同的——藥品必須儲存在受控環境中。就像醫院會確保手術室隔離於一般病房、清潔用品不會混入醫療器材、有備用發電機確保手術中不斷電——藥品倉庫也需要相同層級的管控思維。
blocks.en: Although a pharmaceutical warehouse does not need to meet the standard of a sterile cleanroom, the concept is the same: medicines must be stored in a controlled environment. Just as a hospital keeps the operating room separate from general wards, keeps cleaning supplies away from medical instruments and has a backup generator so that surgery is never interrupted by a power cut, a pharmaceutical warehouse needs the same level of control thinking.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：區域隔離原則
blocks.en: Key Point: The Principle of Area Segregation

blocks.zh: 多個問題強調「隔離」(segregation) 的概念：
blocks.en: Several questions stress the concept of segregation:

blocks.zh: Q6：清潔用品與產品隔離——防止化學污染
blocks.en: Q6: cleaning supplies segregated from product, to prevent chemical contamination

blocks.zh: Q14：盥洗室與儲存區隔離——防止微生物污染
blocks.en: Q14: restrooms segregated from storage areas, to prevent microbial contamination

blocks.zh: Q15：退回/拒收品專用區——防止混入合格庫存
blocks.en: Q15: dedicated area for returned/rejected goods, to prevent mix-up with approved stock

blocks.zh: Q16：重新包裝區獨立——防止交叉污染
blocks.en: Q16: separate repackaging area, to prevent cross-contamination

blocks.zh: 這些隔離要求的核心原則是：不同狀態、不同用途的物品絕不混放。
blocks.en: The core principle behind these segregation requirements is: items of different status or purpose must never be mixed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：備用電源 (Q17-Q19)
blocks.en: Key Point: Backup Power (Q17-Q19)

blocks.zh: 備用電源對於儲存溫度敏感藥品（如疫苗、生物製劑）的倉庫尤為關鍵。稽核時應確認：
blocks.en: Backup power is especially critical for warehouses storing temperature-sensitive medicines (such as vaccines and biologics). During an audit, confirm that:

blocks.zh: 備用電源的持續時間是否足以覆蓋最長可能的停電時間
blocks.en: The duration of the backup power is sufficient to cover the longest possible outage

blocks.zh: 發電機是否定期測試（含實際負載測試，不只是空轉測試）
blocks.en: The generator is tested regularly (including actual load tests, not just no-load run tests)

blocks.zh: 是否有自動切換功能 (Automatic Transfer Switch, ATS)
blocks.en: There is an Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS)

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Q10 要求地板高度高於「合理的潛在洪水水位」？這對哪類藥品影響最大？
blocks.en: Why does Q10 require the floor to be above the "reasonable potential flood level"? Which types of medicines are most affected?

blocks.zh: Q21 提到的「中央監控站環境警報系統」在假日或夜間為何特別重要？
blocks.en: Why is the "environmental alarm system at a central monitoring station" mentioned in Q21 especially important on holidays or at night?

blocks.zh: D. Pest Control（蟲害防治）
blocks.en: D. Pest Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：蟲害防治計劃 (IPM)
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Pest Control Program (IPM)

blocks.zh: Pest Control (蟲害防治) 是藥品倉儲 GDP 中不可忽視的環節。完整的蟲害防治計劃 (Integrated Pest Management, IPM) 應包含：
blocks.en: Pest Control is a part of pharmaceutical storage GDP that cannot be neglected. A complete Integrated Pest Management (IPM) program should include:

blocks.zh: 預防措施：封堵入口、保持清潔、控制食物來源
blocks.en: Preventive measures: sealing entry points, maintaining cleanliness, controlling food sources

blocks.zh: 監測系統：誘餌箱 (Bait Boxes)、電子捕蟲器、定期巡檢
blocks.en: Monitoring systems: bait boxes, electronic insect traps, periodic inspection rounds

blocks.zh: 應對措施：發現蟲害後的處置與根因分析
blocks.en: Response measures: handling and root cause analysis after pests are found

blocks.zh: 文件記錄：服務紀錄、巡檢紀錄、位置圖
blocks.en: Documentation: service records, inspection records, layout diagram

blocks.zh: 重點提示：位置圖的重要性 (Q10)
blocks.en: Key Point: The Importance of the Layout Diagram (Q10)

blocks.zh: 第 10 題要求維護誘餌箱與捕蟲器的位置圖 (Layout Diagram)，這不僅僅是行政要求——它確保：
blocks.en: Question 10 requires a layout diagram of bait boxes and traps to be maintained. This is more than an administrative requirement, because it ensures that:

blocks.zh: 所有裝置均被納入定期服務排程，無遺漏
blocks.en: All devices are included in the routine service schedule with none missed

blocks.zh: 可分析蟲害趨勢與高風險區域
blocks.en: Pest trends and high-risk areas can be analyzed

blocks.zh: 新進人員或外部服務商能快速了解設施布局
blocks.en: New staff or external service providers can quickly understand the facility layout

blocks.zh: 稽核時能驗證所有設備均在指定位置且功能正常
blocks.en: During an audit, it can be verified that all devices are in their designated locations and functioning properly

blocks.zh: 蟲害防治計劃就像社區的保全巡邏：需要有固定的巡邏路線圖（位置圖）、定期巡邏紀錄（服務紀錄）、使用合法的安全設備（EPA 核准清單）、並且有發現異常時的通報與處置機制。沒有巡邏路線圖的保全，可能會漏掉某些死角。
blocks.en: A pest control program is like security patrols in a residential community: it needs a fixed patrol route map (the layout diagram), regular patrol records (service records), legally approved safety equipment (the EPA-approved list) and a reporting and response mechanism when anomalies are found. A security guard without a patrol route map may miss some blind spots.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Q5 強調殺蟲劑必須在 EPA/OSHA/USDA 核准清單上？使用未核准的殺蟲劑可能對藥品造成什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does Q5 stress that pesticides must be on the EPA/OSHA/USDA-approved list? What risks to the medicines could the use of unapproved pesticides create?

blocks.zh: Q4 詢問是否有「蟲害跡象」——在稽核現場時，您會尋找哪些具體的蟲害證據？
blocks.en: Q4 asks about "evidence of pest activity". During an on-site audit, what specific signs of pests would you look for?

blocks.zh: II. PRODUCT CONTROL - E. Product Storage（產品管控 - 產品儲存）
blocks.en: II. PRODUCT CONTROL - E. Product Storage

blocks.zh: 核心概念：產品儲存的關鍵原則
blocks.en: Core Concept: Key Principles of Product Storage

blocks.zh: 產品儲存管控可分為以下關鍵面向：
blocks.en: Product storage controls can be divided into the following key areas:

blocks.zh: 物理隔離 (Physical Segregation)：產品離地存放、牆面間距、不同批號/產品的隔離
blocks.en: Physical Segregation: product stored off the floor, spacing from walls, segregation of different batches/products

blocks.zh: 安全管控 (Security Controls)：管制藥品專區、授權人員限制、DEA 合規
blocks.en: Security Controls: dedicated area for controlled substances, restriction to authorized personnel, DEA compliance

blocks.zh: 收貨驗證 (Receiving Verification)：核對供應商文件、驗收紀錄
blocks.en: Receiving Verification: checking supplier documents and receiving records

blocks.zh: 溫度管控 (Temperature Control)：溫度敏感產品的全程溫控與文件化證據
blocks.en: Temperature Control: end-to-end temperature control of temperature-sensitive products, with documented evidence

blocks.zh: 重點提示：巡檢通道 (Inspection Perimeter)
blocks.en: Key Point: The Inspection Perimeter

blocks.zh: 第 2 題要求產品與外牆保持 6 至 18 英寸（約 15-45 公分）的間距，這稱為巡檢通道 (Inspection Perimeter)。其目的包括：
blocks.en: Question 2 requires product to be kept 6 to 18 inches (about 15-45 cm) from exterior walls. This is called the Inspection Perimeter. Its purposes include:

blocks.zh: 便於蟲害防治巡檢（可觀察牆角是否有蟲害跡象）
blocks.en: Facilitating pest control inspections (signs of pests in corners can be observed)

blocks.zh: 防止牆面水氣或溫度直接影響產品
blocks.en: Preventing moisture or temperature from the wall from directly affecting the product

blocks.zh: 確保空氣流通，維持儲存環境均勻性
blocks.en: Ensuring air circulation and maintaining uniformity of the storage environment

blocks.zh: 便於清潔維護，避免積塵死角
blocks.en: Facilitating cleaning and maintenance and avoiding dust-collecting dead corners

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：收貨如同機場入境檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: Receiving as Airport Immigration Control

blocks.zh: 第 14-15 題描述的收貨驗證流程，就像機場入境檢查：
blocks.en: The receiving verification process described in Questions 14-15 is like airport immigration control:

blocks.zh: 核對文件 = 檢查護照與簽證（核對採購單與供應商文件）
blocks.en: Checking documents = checking the passport and visa (checking the purchase order and supplier documents)

blocks.zh: 查驗身份 = 比對人與證件（核對標籤、產品號、數量、批號）
blocks.en: Verifying identity = matching the person to the documents (checking labels, product number, quantity and batch number)

blocks.zh: 檢查狀況 = 行李掃描（確認物理狀態完好）
blocks.en: Checking condition = baggage scanning (confirming the physical condition is intact)

blocks.zh: 記錄入境 = 蓋入境章（保留收貨紀錄，含到期日與運輸溫度要求）
blocks.en: Recording the entry = the entry stamp (retaining receiving records, including expiry date and shipping temperature requirements)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：管制藥品的特殊要求 (Q9-Q11)
blocks.en: Key Point: Special Requirements for Controlled Substances (Q9-Q11)

blocks.zh: 管制藥品 (Controlled Drugs/Substances) 在美國受 DEA (Drug Enforcement Agency) 嚴格監管。儲存管制藥品的設施必須：
blocks.en: Controlled drugs/substances are strictly regulated in the US by the DEA (Drug Enforcement Agency). A facility storing controlled substances must:

blocks.zh: 設有獨立的安全區域（上鎖、監控）
blocks.en: Have a separate secure area (locked and monitored)

blocks.zh: 嚴格限制授權人員進出
blocks.en: Strictly restrict access to authorized personnel

blocks.zh: 維護完整的收發紀錄
blocks.en: Maintain complete receipt and issue records

blocks.zh: 通過 DEA 合規檢查
blocks.en: Pass DEA compliance inspections

blocks.zh: Q5 提到「防止庫存被誤移轉給共用設施的其他公司」——在共用倉庫（multi-tenant warehouse）中，您會建議哪些管控措施？
blocks.en: Q5 mentions "preventing inventory from being mistakenly transferred to other companies sharing the facility". In a multi-tenant warehouse, what controls would you recommend?

blocks.zh: Q17 要求溫度敏感產品有「文件化證據」支持實際儲存條件。什麼樣的證據才足夠？溫度紀錄的保存期限應為多久？
blocks.en: Q17 requires "documented evidence" for temperature-sensitive products to support the actual storage conditions. What kind of evidence is sufficient? How long should temperature records be retained?

blocks.zh: F. Temperature Control/Calibration Storage（溫度管控/校正 - 儲存）
blocks.en: F. Temperature Control/Calibration Storage

blocks.zh: 核心概念：溫度管控體系的完整架構
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Complete Architecture of a Temperature Control System

blocks.zh: 本節 22 個問題構成了一個完整的溫度管控體系，可分為四大層次：
blocks.en: The 22 questions in this section make up a complete temperature control system, which can be divided into four levels:

blocks.zh: 第一層：基礎設施 (Q1-Q2)：倉庫溫控系統、冷藏/冷凍區
blocks.en: Level 1: Infrastructure (Q1-Q2): warehouse temperature control systems, refrigerated/frozen areas

blocks.zh: 第二層：監測與校正 (Q3-Q9)：校正設備、警報系統、紀錄管理
blocks.en: Level 2: Monitoring and calibration (Q3-Q9): calibrated equipment, alarm systems, record management

blocks.zh: 第三層：驗證與映射 (Q11-Q13)：溫度映射、定期重新驗證
blocks.en: Level 3: Qualification and mapping (Q11-Q13): temperature mapping, periodic re-qualification

blocks.zh: 第四層：應急與維護 (Q14-Q22)：預防維護、停電應對、緊急計劃
blocks.en: Level 4: Contingency and maintenance (Q14-Q22): preventive maintenance, response to power outages, emergency plans

blocks.zh: 重點提示：溫度映射 (Temperature Mapping) 的關鍵要求
blocks.en: Key Point: Key Requirements for Temperature Mapping

blocks.zh: Q11-Q13 涵蓋的溫度映射是 GDP 合規的核心要求：
blocks.en: The temperature mapping covered in Q11-Q13 is a core GDP compliance requirement:

blocks.zh: 季節性極端：必須在夏季最熱與冬季最冷時進行映射
blocks.en: Seasonal extremes: mapping must be performed in the hottest part of summer and the coldest part of winter

blocks.zh: 最少 3 天：確保涵蓋營運活動的高峰期（如大量進出貨時段）
blocks.en: Minimum of 3 days: ensure the study covers peak operating activity (such as periods of heavy receiving and shipping)

blocks.zh: 每 3 年重新評估：評估是否需要重新映射（如設備更換、布局變更、新增區域等）
blocks.en: Re-evaluation every 3 years: assess whether re-mapping is needed (for example, after equipment replacement, layout changes or the addition of new areas)

blocks.zh: 映射結果用於確定監測探針的最佳放置位置（高溫點與低溫點）
blocks.en: The mapping results are used to determine the best locations for monitoring probes (hot spots and cold spots)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT，平均動力學溫度)
blocks.en: Core Concept: Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT)

blocks.zh: MKT 不是簡單的算術平均溫度，而是考慮溫度波動對產品降解影響的加權計算值。它基於 Arrhenius 方程式，反映了溫度偏高時對產品穩定性的不成比例影響。
blocks.en: MKT is not a simple arithmetic average temperature but a weighted value that takes into account the effect of temperature fluctuations on product degradation. It is based on the Arrhenius equation and reflects the disproportionate effect that elevated temperatures have on product stability.

blocks.zh: 例如：一個區域在 20-25°C 間波動，其 MKT 可能接近 23°C，但如果有短暫的 35°C 偏移，MKT 會顯著高於算術平均值。這是因為高溫對藥品降解的影響是指數級的，而非線性的。
blocks.en: For example, if an area fluctuates between 20 and 25°C, its MKT may be close to 23°C, but if there is a brief excursion to 35°C, the MKT will be significantly higher than the arithmetic mean. This is because the effect of high temperature on drug degradation is exponential, not linear.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：溫控體系如同智慧家庭系統
blocks.en: Analogy: The Temperature Control System as a Smart Home System

blocks.zh: 完整的溫控體系就像現代智慧家庭：
blocks.en: A complete temperature control system is like a modern smart home:

blocks.zh: 溫控設備 = 中央空調（維持基本溫度）
blocks.en: Temperature control equipment = central air conditioning (maintains the baseline temperature)

blocks.zh: 監測探針 = 各房間的溫度感測器（了解每個角落的實際溫度）
blocks.en: Monitoring probes = temperature sensors in each room (reveal the actual temperature in every corner)

blocks.zh: 警報系統 = 手機推播通知（溫度異常時立即告警）
blocks.en: Alarm system = phone push notifications (immediate alerts when the temperature is abnormal)

blocks.zh: 溫度映射 = 建屋前的風場模擬（找出最熱和最冷的角落）
blocks.en: Temperature mapping = airflow simulation before building the house (finding the hottest and coldest corners)

blocks.zh: 備用電源 = 不斷電系統 UPS（停電時維持關鍵設備運作）
blocks.en: Backup power = uninterruptible power supply (UPS) (keeps critical equipment running during a power outage)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：棧板管理 (Q22) 的特殊考量
blocks.en: Key Point: Special Considerations for Pallet Management (Q22)

blocks.zh: Q22 提及的棧板管理程序 (Pallet Management Program) 是一個容易被忽略但重要的查核點。木棧板的含水量規格之所以重要，是因為：
blocks.en: The Pallet Management Program mentioned in Q22 is an easily overlooked but important audit point. The moisture content specification for wooden pallets matters because:

blocks.zh: 潮濕木棧板可能促進黴菌生長，污染藥品
blocks.en: Damp wooden pallets can promote mold growth and contaminate medicines

blocks.zh: 木材含水量過高可能在冷庫中結冰，影響結構強度
blocks.en: Excessive moisture in the wood may freeze in cold storage and weaken structural strength

blocks.zh: 國際運輸中，木棧板須符合 ISPM 15 燻蒸或熱處理規範
blocks.en: In international shipping, wooden pallets must comply with ISPM 15 fumigation or heat treatment requirements

blocks.zh: Q7 要求警報設定「能允許及時採取矯正行動」——這意味著警報設定點應該在限值之內（預警）還是在限值上？為什麼？
blocks.en: Q7 requires alarm settings to "allow timely corrective action". Does this mean alarm set points should be inside the limits (pre-alarm) or at the limits? Why?

blocks.zh: 如果校正時發現某溫度記錄器讀數偏差超出允許範圍 (Q15)，應如何處理過去一段時間該記錄器的數據？需要回溯評估嗎？
blocks.en: If calibration finds that a temperature recorder's readings deviate beyond the allowable range (Q15), how should the data from that recorder over the preceding period be handled? Is a retrospective assessment needed?

blocks.zh: G. Temperature Control Distribution（溫度管控 - 配送）
blocks.en: G. Temperature Control Distribution

blocks.zh: 核心概念：配送溫控 vs. 儲存溫控
blocks.en: Core Concept: Distribution Temperature Control vs. Storage Temperature Control

blocks.zh: G 節專注於配送（運輸）過程中的溫度監控，與 F 節的儲存溫控形成互補。配送溫控的特殊挑戰包括：
blocks.en: Section G focuses on temperature monitoring during distribution (transportation) and complements the storage temperature control in Section F. The particular challenges of distribution temperature control include:

blocks.zh: 移動環境：無法像倉庫一樣固定管控
blocks.en: Moving environment: it cannot be controlled at a fixed location as in a warehouse

blocks.zh: 多方參與：涉及發貨方、承運商、收貨方
blocks.en: Multiple parties: the shipper, carrier and receiver are all involved

blocks.zh: 數據完整性：必須防止溫度紀錄被竄改
blocks.en: Data integrity: temperature records must be protected from tampering

blocks.zh: 即時性：偏差發生時需快速回傳數據進行分析
blocks.en: Timeliness: when a deviation occurs, data must be returned quickly for analysis

blocks.zh: 重點提示：數據完整性與防竄改 (Q5)
blocks.en: Key Point: Data Integrity and Tamper Prevention (Q5)

blocks.zh: Q5 詢問是否有防止溫度紀錄被操縱的系統。這是 Data Integrity (數據完整性) 在 GDP 中的直接體現。常見的防竄改措施包括：
blocks.en: Q5 asks whether there is a system to prevent manipulation of temperature records. This is a direct application of Data Integrity in GDP. Common tamper-prevention measures include:

blocks.zh: 使用一次性不可重置的 data-logger
blocks.en: Use of single-use, non-resettable data loggers

blocks.zh: 數據下載後自動鎖定，不可修改原始數據
blocks.en: Automatic locking of data after download so that the original data cannot be modified

blocks.zh: 電子簽名與稽核追蹤功能
blocks.en: Electronic signatures and audit trail functionality

blocks.zh: 數據直接傳輸至中央系統，減少人為介入
blocks.en: Direct transmission of data to a central system, minimizing human intervention

blocks.zh: 重點提示：多層級警報區域 (Q6)
blocks.en: Key Point: Multi-Level Alarm Zones (Q6)

blocks.zh: Q6 提到的 multi-level-alarm zones（多層級警報區域）是一個進階概念。例如，對於 2-8°C 冷鏈產品：
blocks.en: The multi-level-alarm zones mentioned in Q6 are an advanced concept. For example, for a 2-8°C cold chain product:

blocks.zh: 綠色區域：2-8°C（正常範圍）
blocks.en: Green zone: 2-8°C (normal range)

blocks.zh: 黃色區域（預警）：0-2°C 或 8-15°C（短期可接受，需關注）
blocks.en: Yellow zone (pre-alarm): 0-2°C or 8-15°C (acceptable for a short time, requires attention)

blocks.zh: 紅色區域（警報）：<0°C 或 >15°C（立即行動，評估產品影響）
blocks.en: Red zone (alarm): <0°C or >15°C (immediate action, assess the impact on the product)

blocks.zh: 這些區域的設定必須基於產品的穩定性數據 (Stability Data)。
blocks.en: The setting of these zones must be based on the product's stability data.

blocks.zh: 配送溫控就像「冷藏外送服務」——餐廳（製造商）做好冷藏甜點後，外送員（承運商）必須使用保冷袋（溫控包裝）、即時監測溫度（data-logger）、抵達後由客戶（收貨方）確認溫度紀錄。若溫度曾超標，要立即回報餐廳評估甜點是否還能食用（偏差調查）。
blocks.en: Distribution temperature control is like a "refrigerated food delivery service": after the restaurant (the manufacturer) prepares a chilled dessert, the courier (the carrier) must use an insulated bag (temperature-controlled packaging), monitor the temperature in real time (data logger), and, on arrival, the customer (the receiver) confirms the temperature record. If the temperature has ever been exceeded, the restaurant must be told immediately so it can assess whether the dessert is still fit to eat (deviation investigation).

blocks.zh: Q4 提到收貨方需要有能力下載和解讀 data-logger 數據。如果收貨方是一家小型藥局，如何確保他們具備這項能力？
blocks.en: Q4 mentions that the receiver must be able to download and interpret data-logger data. If the receiver is a small pharmacy, how can you ensure they have this capability?

blocks.zh: Q9 提到多次使用設備的「出廠校正 (exit calibration)」——這與一般校正有何不同？為什麼多次使用設備需要這個額外步驟？
blocks.en: Q9 mentions "exit calibration" for equipment used multiple times. How does this differ from ordinary calibration? Why do multiple-use devices need this additional step?

blocks.zh: H. Inventory Control（庫存管控）
blocks.en: H. Inventory Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：FEFO vs. FIFO
blocks.en: Core Concept: FEFO vs. FIFO

blocks.zh: Q1 特別強調的是 FEFO (First Expiration, First Out，先到期先出)，而非一般倉儲常用的 FIFO (First In, First Out，先進先出)。這是藥品配送的特殊要求：
blocks.en: Q1 specifically emphasizes FEFO (First Expiration, First Out) rather than the FIFO (First In, First Out) commonly used in general warehousing. This is a special requirement of pharmaceutical distribution:

blocks.zh: FIFO：以入庫時間排序出庫（一般倉儲）
blocks.en: FIFO: stock is issued in order of receipt (general warehousing)

blocks.zh: FEFO：以到期日排序出庫（藥品倉儲）
blocks.en: FEFO: stock is issued in order of expiry date (pharmaceutical warehousing)

blocks.zh: 使用 FEFO 是因為同一產品的不同批次可能有不同的到期日，確保即將到期的產品優先出庫，可減少過期報廢。
blocks.en: FEFO is used because different batches of the same product may have different expiry dates, and issuing the soonest-expiring product first reduces write-offs due to expiry.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：不合格品管控的完整鏈條 (Q2-Q4)
blocks.en: Key Point: The Complete Chain of Nonconforming Product Control (Q2-Q4)

blocks.zh: Q2 至 Q4 構成了不合格品管控 (Nonconforming Product Control) 的完整流程：
blocks.en: Q2 to Q4 make up the complete process of Nonconforming Product Control:

blocks.zh: Q2 - 程序定義：誰負責發出 QA Hold？如何通知相關方？如何執行？
blocks.en: Q2 - Procedure definition: who is responsible for issuing a QA Hold? How are the relevant parties notified? How is it carried out?

blocks.zh: Q3 - 標示與隔離：實體標示（如紅色標籤）或系統鎖定（blocked status）
blocks.en: Q3 - Labeling and segregation: physical labeling (such as red tags) or system locking (blocked status)

blocks.zh: Q4 - 處置與追蹤：銷毀決定必須有文件記錄，且可追溯至最終銷毀
blocks.en: Q4 - Disposition and tracking: the decision to destroy must be documented and traceable through to final destruction

blocks.zh: 這三步缺一不可——如果只隔離但不追蹤銷毀，不合格品可能再次流入供應鏈。
blocks.en: None of these three steps can be omitted: if product is only segregated but its destruction is not tracked, nonconforming product could re-enter the supply chain.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：庫存管控如同圖書館管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Inventory Control as Library Management

blocks.zh: 藥品庫存管控就像管理一座圖書館：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical inventory control is like running a library:

blocks.zh: FEFO = 先將即將到期的期刊放在架上供閱覽
blocks.en: FEFO = putting the journals that are about to expire on the shelf first for readers

blocks.zh: 循環盤點 (Cycle Count) = 定期清點各書架的藏書是否與目錄一致
blocks.en: Cycle Count = periodically counting the books on each shelf to check they match the catalog

blocks.zh: QA Hold = 將有問題的書標記為「暫停借閱」
blocks.en: QA Hold = marking a problem book as "not available for loan"

blocks.zh: 召回紀錄 = 追蹤某本問題書被借給了哪些讀者，通知歸還
blocks.en: Recall records = tracking which readers a problem book was lent to, and notifying them to return it

blocks.zh: 隔離區 = 專門的「待處理」書架，與正常藏書分開
blocks.en: Quarantine area = a dedicated "pending action" shelf kept apart from the normal collection

blocks.zh: 重點提示：溫控產品的時間管理 (Q14-Q15)
blocks.en: Key Point: Time Management for Temperature-Controlled Products (Q14-Q15)

blocks.zh: 對溫度敏感產品而言，從收貨碼頭到指定儲存環境的時間（put-away time，上架時間）是關鍵的品質風險點：
blocks.en: For temperature-sensitive products, the time from the receiving dock to the designated storage environment (put-away time) is a key quality risk point:

blocks.zh: 必須有程序化的上架流程，明確規定最大允許時間
blocks.en: There must be a procedural put-away process that clearly specifies the maximum allowable time

blocks.zh: 允許時間必須有穩定性數據支持（不能隨意設定）
blocks.en: The allowable time must be supported by stability data (it cannot be set arbitrarily)

blocks.zh: 在非受控環境中的暴露時間必須被限制和記錄
blocks.en: Exposure time in uncontrolled environments must be limited and recorded

blocks.zh: 對於高敏感產品（如 mRNA 疫苗），上架時間可能以分鐘計
blocks.en: For highly sensitive products (such as mRNA vaccines), put-away time may be measured in minutes

blocks.zh: 重點提示：電腦化系統驗證 (Q7)
blocks.en: Key Point: Computerized System Validation (Q7)

blocks.zh: Q7 提到影響批次追溯性的電腦化庫存系統必須經過驗證 (Validation)。這與 FDA 21 CFR Part 11 及 EU GMP Annex 11 的要求一致。驗證應確保系統能正確記錄、儲存和檢索批號資訊，且資料不會被意外或蓄意修改。
blocks.en: Q7 states that computerized inventory systems affecting batch traceability must be validated. This is consistent with the requirements of FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11. Validation should ensure that the system correctly records, stores and retrieves batch number information, and that the data cannot be changed accidentally or deliberately.

blocks.zh: Q9 詢問循環盤點差異的調查門檻。您認為什麼樣的差異門檻是合理的？是否應該所有差異都調查，還是只調查超過某個比例的差異？
blocks.en: Q9 asks about the investigation threshold for cycle count discrepancies. What discrepancy threshold do you think is reasonable? Should all discrepancies be investigated, or only those exceeding a certain percentage?

blocks.zh: Q13 提到「防止已召回產品重新入庫」的程序。在 WMS（倉庫管理系統）中，您會如何設計這個防呆機制？
blocks.en: Q13 mentions a procedure to "prevent recalled product from being returned to stock". How would you design this error-proofing mechanism in a WMS (warehouse management system)?

blocks.zh: I. Product Distribution（產品配送）
blocks.en: I. Product Distribution

blocks.zh: 核心概念：產品配送管控的三大支柱
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Pillars of Product Distribution Control

blocks.zh: 本節 13 個問題聚焦於產品從倉庫發出到抵達客戶的全過程管控：
blocks.en: The 13 questions in this section focus on control of the whole process from the product leaving the warehouse to its arrival at the customer:

blocks.zh: 追溯性 (Traceability)：按批號維護配送紀錄 (Q1, Q10)，確保召回時能快速定位
blocks.en: Traceability: maintaining distribution records by lot number (Q1, Q10) so that product can be located quickly during a recall

blocks.zh: 包裝與運輸驗證：運輸容器的溫度/時間驗證 (Q4-Q5)、車輛確認 (Q7-Q8)
blocks.en: Packaging and shipping qualification: temperature/time qualification of shipping containers (Q4-Q5), vehicle qualification (Q7-Q8)

blocks.zh: 程序管控：出貨 SOP (Q2-Q3)、標示要求 (Q6)、召回程序 (Q11)
blocks.en: Procedural control: shipping SOPs (Q2-Q3), labeling requirements (Q6), recall procedure (Q11)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：運輸容器驗證 (Q5) vs. 車輛確認 (Q8)
blocks.en: Key Point: Shipping Container Validation (Q5) vs. Vehicle Qualification (Q8)

blocks.zh: 這兩者是不同層次的管控：
blocks.en: These are controls at two different levels:

blocks.zh: 運輸容器驗證 (Shipping Container Validation)：針對保溫箱、保冷袋等包裝本身，驗證其在特定環境條件下能維持目標溫度的時間。屬於「被動溫控 (Passive Temperature Control)」。
blocks.en: Shipping Container Validation: for the packaging itself, such as insulated boxes and cold bags, it verifies how long the packaging can maintain the target temperature under specified environmental conditions. This is "Passive Temperature Control".

blocks.zh: 車輛確認 (Vehicle Qualification)：針對冷藏車、冷凍車等主動溫控車輛，確認其冷機能力、溫度均勻性、門開啟後的恢復時間等。屬於「主動溫控 (Active Temperature Control)」。
blocks.en: Vehicle Qualification: for actively temperature-controlled vehicles such as refrigerated and freezer trucks, it confirms the refrigeration unit capacity, temperature uniformity, recovery time after door opening and so on. This is "Active Temperature Control".

blocks.zh: 兩者互補，選擇取決於運輸距離、環境條件、產品要求等因素。
blocks.en: The two complement each other, and the choice depends on factors such as transport distance, environmental conditions and product requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：配送管控如同快遞系統
blocks.en: Analogy: Distribution Control as a Courier System

blocks.zh: 藥品配送管控就像高規格的快遞服務：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical distribution control is like a high-specification courier service:

blocks.zh: 批號追蹤 = 快遞包裹追蹤號碼（每一步都有紀錄）
blocks.en: Lot tracking = the courier parcel tracking number (every step is recorded)

blocks.zh: 容器驗證 = 測試保冷袋在夏天能保冷多久
blocks.en: Container validation = testing how long a cold bag keeps its contents cold in summer

blocks.zh: 召回程序 = 快遞召回機制（發現問題立即通知所有收件人）
blocks.en: Recall procedure = the courier recall mechanism (all recipients are notified immediately when a problem is found)

blocks.zh: 收貨方通知 = 告訴收件人「此包裹需冷藏，請立即開箱」
blocks.en: Receiver notification = telling the recipient "this parcel requires refrigeration, please open it immediately"

blocks.zh: 重點提示：醫藥樣品的管控 (Q13)
blocks.en: Key Point: Control of Medical Samples (Q13)

blocks.zh: Q13 是一個經常被忽略但非常重要的查核點：醫藥樣品 (Medical Samples) 和促銷材料的配送是否遵循與商業產品相同的 GMP/GDP 標準。
blocks.en: Q13 is an audit point that is often overlooked but very important: whether distribution of medical samples and promotional materials follows the same GMP/GDP standards as commercial product.

blocks.zh: 許多企業認為樣品「只是樣品」而放鬆管控，但樣品最終也會被患者使用，其品質要求與商業產品完全相同。法規要求樣品必須接受與正式產品相同的儲存、運輸和追溯管控。
blocks.en: Many companies relax controls because samples are "just samples", but samples are ultimately used by patients, and their quality requirements are exactly the same as for commercial product. Regulations require that samples be subject to the same storage, transport and traceability controls as regular product.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：未放行產品的配送 (Q9)
blocks.en: Key Point: Distribution of Unreleased Product (Q9)

blocks.zh: 某些供應鏈模式允許在最終 QA 放行前先將產品運送至配送中心（ship-to-hold 模式）。這種做法可縮短供應鏈時間，但必須有嚴格的 QA Hold 機制，確保未放行產品絕不會被分發給終端客戶。系統必須能在放行前鎖定出貨。
blocks.en: Some supply chain models allow product to be shipped to the distribution center before final QA release (the ship-to-hold model). This practice can shorten supply chain time, but it requires a strict QA Hold mechanism to ensure that unreleased product is never distributed to end customers. The system must be able to block shipment until release.

blocks.zh: Q10 要求配送紀錄能支持「快速召回」。在您看來，「快速」意味著多少時間？FDA 對召回響應時間有何期望？
blocks.en: Q10 requires distribution records to support a "rapid recall". In your view, how much time does "rapid" mean? What does the FDA expect for recall response time?

blocks.zh: Q12 詢問如何確保收貨地點知曉特殊處理要求。除了在包裝上貼標籤，您還能想到哪些方法？
blocks.en: Q12 asks how to ensure the receiving site is aware of special handling requirements. Besides labels on the packaging, what other methods can you think of?
